title: Checkpoint the software decoder inside a GOP

definition.title: Checkpoint the software decoder inside a GOP
definition.source_excerpt: Export a versioned codec-aware software-decoder continuation state at safe picture boundaries, including reference pictures and bookkeeping, then restore it during exact scrubbing. Do not memcpy pointer-bearing contexts or assume browser state export.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse.
definition.minimum_probe: One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse. One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.primary_metric: Time to the requested exact or explicitly approximate preview, total prerequisite work and retained state.
definition.scope_contract: Correct source/time/target and agreed fidelity. Approximate results cannot populate exact caches or qualify normal playback.
definition.negative_control: Move backward, request a non-RAP dependency, change source or cancel a pending request; stale previews must never become current.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop at E3 preview/index/state infrastructure. Keep proof of a bounded mechanism distinct from a production preview implementation.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Existing preview or decoder access path. Its absence is setup cost, not permission to create a complete preview service.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Existing source-grounded definition imported; acceptance criteria must be reviewed before a new run.

prepare.basis: Actual codec-aware retained/rebased state copier wrapped by versioned in-process handle; no raw context memcpy.

screen.basis: Checkpoint inside one GOP restores repeated suffixes after original decoder continuation.

correctness.basis: 3x30 full frames/PTS exact per7paired jobs; source/runtime/owner/version/cut and dropped-handle controls; all owned contexts retired.

performance.basis: Prepared-runtime complete3scrub job including checkpoint construction median16.57% faster;95% paired-bootstrap saving1.565–22.23%; cold startup variability kept separate.

results.basis: Prior component-scoped pursue remains unchanged. Whole-player readiness: Not a JS policy or existing player ABI toggle. Faithful integration needs decoder-internal safe-boundary state plus demux position, mpv decode/filter/output queues, A/V clocks, cancellation and retained checkpoint lifetime. Existing research wrapper only owns a standalone single-thread AVC decoder. Narrow optional preview caching or already-pending batching has less decoder-internal integration burden when those requested workloads exist.
